stop_records.reaction: I am stopping here. I liked these eight people in the short game - Nerys and her telescope, Sevim and the boy she called lazy. But the storm ended in a receipt, the cabin never found ground on this phone, and the longer day buries them under rules: dated reports, not a new count; learn about this resident before a collaboration she already told me. I pressed I am stopping in Feedback; it filled the note with I am stopping by itself. I typed nothing and did not submit. I would not leave it running. I might come back another evening on desktop, for Sevim, if I could answer her.
